description: React component for querying and displaying vector store documents, including UI for input, configuration, and document retrieval results.

methods.name: handleVectorStoreProviderDataChange
methods.description: Updates the selected vector store provider inputs based on user input.

methods.name: chunkSelected
methods.description: Handles selection of a document chunk to show in expanded view.

methods.name: handleEnter
methods.description: Handles key press events in the query input, triggers query on Enter.

methods.name: doQuery
methods.description: Executes the vector store query with current input.

methods.name: saveConfig
methods.description: Saves the current vector store configuration.

methods.name: fetchVectorStoreDetails
methods.description: Fetches and sets details for the vector store node.
